fieldData.name: Verve Ventures
fieldData.profile: Verve Ventures is a Swiss venture investor that has backed Europe's most transformative deep tech companies for 15 years. It focuses on health and bio, the future of computing, and energy and resources.

fieldData.name: VentureFriends
fieldData.profile: VentureFriends is an early-stage European venture firm based in Greece. It writes first tickets of €500K to €3M at pre-seed and seed for ambitious founders across Europe and MENA.

fieldData.name: UVC Partners
fieldData.profile: UVC Partners is a German venture capital firm that partners with B2B startups across Europe from their earliest stages up to Series A. It initially invests €500,000 to €10 million and continues to support companies for the long haul.

fieldData.name: Syndicate One
fieldData.profile: Syndicate One is a Belgian community of founders, operators and venture capitalists working to elevate the Belgian tech ecosystem. It provides seed capital along with hands-on operational advice, mentorship and access to its network.

fieldData.name: Supernode
fieldData.focus: Health, AI, Fintech, E-commerce and marketplaces
fieldData.profile: Supernode Ventures is a venture fund founded in 2017 by Laurel Touby, a former founder and investor, and now co-led with Jessica Federer. It invests in women-led companies, and its first fund backed more than 50 early-stage companies in fintech, healthtech and B2B software.

fieldData.name: StageOne Ventures
fieldData.profile: StageOne Ventures is an Israeli seed-stage venture firm that leads investments in Israel-related entrepreneurs. It focuses on transformative deep tech startups solving complex enterprise challenges.

fieldData.name: Spero Ventures
fieldData.profile: Spero Ventures is a boutique venture firm built for purpose-led companies. It backs founders using technology to tackle humanity's biggest challenges, on the view that tomorrow's most valuable companies will be the ones solving today's most meaningful problems.

fieldData.name: SmartFin Capital
fieldData.profile: SmartFin Capital is a Belgian venture capital fund that invests in European B2B technology companies. It offers founders capital along with clear feedback and guidance from people who have built companies before.

fieldData.name: Simon Capital
fieldData.profile: Simon Capital is a German venture firm that invests in driven founders reshaping their industries for a sustainable next generation. Its portfolio has included Waterdrop, the Austrian "microdrink" brand.

fieldData.name: Senovo
fieldData.profile: Senovo is a European early-stage venture firm in Germany that invests €1-5 million in B2B enterprise software at seed and Series A. It focuses on AI-first products, cybersecurity and industrial technology.

fieldData.name: ReGen Ventures
fieldData.profile: Onto Ventures (formerly ReGen Ventures) is an Australian venture firm that backs founders engineering solutions to existential challenges in climate, food, water and energy. It invests at the pre-seed and seed stages.

fieldData.name: Presto Ventures
fieldData.profile: Presto Ventures is a Czech venture firm that connects frontier technologies, strategic investment and purpose to create a safer, more secure future. It backs tech entrepreneurs working where software alone cannot solve the challenge.

fieldData.name: Pi Labs
fieldData.profile: Pi Labs is a UK venture firm, founded in 2015, that backs innovators transforming the built world and its impact on people, business and the environment. It invests globally from pre-seed to Series A.

fieldData.name: One Peak
fieldData.profile: One Peak is a UK growth investor with more than $4 billion in assets under management, backing entrepreneurs building iconic software scale-ups. Its portfolio has included Neo4j, Keepit and Spryker.

fieldData.name: Octopus Ventures
fieldData.stage: Pre-seed, Seed, Series A, Series B
fieldData.profile: Octopus Ventures is a UK venture capital firm that invests in the people, ideas and industries that will change the world. It backs founders building a better tomorrow, from pre-seed to Series B.

fieldData.name: Northzone
fieldData.focus: Fintech, SaaS and enterprise software, Consumer, AI, Future of work
fieldData.profile: Northzone is a multi-stage venture capital firm operating across Europe and the US. Since 1996 it has backed more than 250 companies, including Spotify, Klarna, Spring Health and Black Forest Labs.

fieldData.name: Meron Capital
fieldData.focus: AI, Cybersecurity, Fintech, Digital-Health, Climate-Tech, Robotics
fieldData.profile: Meron Capital is a Tel Aviv seed fund that leads pre-seed and seed rounds for Israeli founders building category-defining companies. It works out of Herzl 2, the 1909 house of Tel Aviv's founder.

fieldData.name: Mendoza Ventures
fieldData.profile: Mendoza Ventures is a US venture fund that invests in technology companies modernizing financial services, insurance and manufacturing, with a focus on AI, cybersecurity and fintech. It was started by Adrian and Senofer Mendoza after a technology exit and now runs three funds.

fieldData.name: MPM Capital
fieldData.profile: MPM Capital, through MPM BioImpact, builds and supports companies that transform patient outcomes. It invests in private and public companies across the drug development process, turning scientific breakthroughs into life-saving medicines.

fieldData.name: Lumira Ventures
fieldData.profile: Lumira Ventures is Canada's largest life sciences venture capital firm, headquartered in Toronto. It invests in healthcare innovators from early-stage to revenue-generating companies in biotech, biotherapeutics and medical devices.

fieldData.name: Lead Edge Capital
fieldData.profile: Lead Edge Capital is a growth equity firm investing in software, internet and tech-enabled businesses. It is backed by a network of more than 700 investors, including successful executives and entrepreneurs.

fieldData.name: Laton Ventures
fieldData.profile: Laton Ventures is a Turkish venture firm focused on gaming and apps, backed by more than 35 gaming industry veterans. It invests at pre-seed and seed in mobile, cross-platform and AI-enhanced games and apps worldwide.

fieldData.name: La Famiglia
fieldData.profile: La Famiglia is a European seed and growth-stage venture capital fund based in Germany. It backs tech entrepreneurs across Europe and the US, with a focus on B2B software.

fieldData.name: Jerusalem Venture Partners
fieldData.profile: Jerusalem Venture Partners (JVP) is an Israeli venture firm with $1.9 billion in assets under management and 165 companies built. It invests in AI, cybersecurity, fintech, insurtech and climate tech.

fieldData.name: Industry Ventures
fieldData.profile: Industry Ventures is a US venture firm that has pioneered flexible capital across the venture life cycle since 2000, from seed and early-stage investing to secondaries. Its funds span direct seed investments, investments in other venture funds and secondary purchases of startup shares.

fieldData.name: Hiro Capital
fieldData.profile: HIRO Capital is a founder-led European venture fund investing from Series A to scale-up. Its areas include spatial AI, deep tech, next-generation cloud, robotics, games, space and defence.

fieldData.name: Highland Europe
fieldData.profile: Highland Europe provides growth capital to exceptional software and internet teams across Europe. It recently raised a €1.1 billion sixth fund and led rounds such as Adaptyv's $40 million Series A.

fieldData.name: Hetz Ventures
fieldData.profile: Hetz Ventures is an Israeli seed-stage venture firm with $500 million in assets under management. It leads rounds in AI, data infrastructure and cybersecurity, and its exits include Granulate, Prompt Security and Silk Security.

fieldData.name: Headline Growth
fieldData.stage: Seed, Series A, Series B, Growth
fieldData.profile: Headline is a global venture capital firm with teams across the US, Europe, Asia and Brazil. It invests across software, AI, consumer and fintech, and leads rounds at every stage.

fieldData.name: HV Capital
fieldData.focus: Internet, Mobile, Software, Health, Finance, Digital-Media
fieldData.profile: HV Capital is a German venture capital firm that provides capital and conviction to founders. It started in the early 2000s with consumer internet, expanded into enterprise software and fintech, and now also backs deep tech; portfolio company Exein recently became Europe's most valuable cybersecurity startup.

fieldData.name: Grove Ventures
fieldData.profile: Grove Ventures is an early-stage venture capital fund in Israel that partners with seed and early-stage founders. It positions itself as more than funding, with a team that builds alongside its companies.

fieldData.name: Greenfield Partners
fieldData.profile: Greenfield Partners is a global fund focused on early growth-stage technology and tech-enabled businesses, with a dual presence in New York and Tel Aviv. Its team combines investing and operating experience, deep Israeli roots and a global network.

fieldData.name: Graham & Walker
fieldData.profile: Graham & Walker is an early-stage venture capital firm that invests in mission-driven founders who break the VC mold. It backs authentic, relentless builders with power-law potential.

fieldData.name: Golden Ventures
fieldData.profile: Golden Ventures is a seed-stage venture capital fund based in Toronto that invests across North America. It backs bold teams and their transformative ideas, including Canadian fintech Float.

fieldData.name: Glilot Capital Partners
fieldData.stage: Pre-seed, Seed, Series A, Series B, Growth
fieldData.profile: Glilot Capital Partners is an Israeli venture firm that invests in seed, Series A and Series B enterprise software, cybersecurity and AI companies. It has raised $1.3 billion and supports founders across the company lifecycle.

fieldData.name: Genesys Capital
fieldData.profile: Genesys Capital is one of Canada's leading venture capital firms, investing in early-stage healthcare and biotechnology companies. It has more than 25 years of experience backing medical breakthroughs.

fieldData.name: Future Energy Ventures
fieldData.profile: Future Energy Ventures is a German venture firm that partners with ambitious founders building the future energy system. It believes the future of energy will be defined by electrification and orchestration across power, transport, buildings, industry and digital infrastructure.

fieldData.name: Fusion
fieldData.profile: Fusion is a venture fund and accelerator for Israeli startups expanding to the US. It provides early-stage founders with their first institutional capital and a support system to scale in the US market.

fieldData.name: Fuel Ventures
fieldData.profile: Fuel Ventures is a UK venture firm created by entrepreneurs for entrepreneurs. Its funds invest between £150,000 and £3 million in tech companies with early commercial traction, with a focus on marketplaces, platforms and SaaS.

fieldData.name: Foundamental
fieldData.profile: Foundamental is a venture firm in Germany that is the first partner to founders re-creating the real world, with a focus on construction and the built environment. It invests as early as day zero, leading first institutional rounds with first checks of $500,000 to $5 million.

fieldData.name: Forbion
fieldData.profile: Forbion is a global venture capital firm based in the Netherlands, dedicated to advancing groundbreaking biotech innovations and other sustainable solutions that improve human health and the planet. It invests from the earliest stages through to later rounds in life sciences companies.

fieldData.name: Focal
fieldData.profile: Focal is a venture firm that exclusively backs AI-native builders at inception, with speed and conviction. It aims to be the first believer for technical founders with moonshot ambitions.

fieldData.name: Endeit Capital
fieldData.stage: Seed, Series A, Series B, Growth
fieldData.profile: Endeit Capital is a Dutch growth investor that helps Europe's scale-ups grow into global leaders. Its portfolio includes companies such as Rabot Energy and Noah.

fieldData.name: EnBW New Ventures
fieldData.profile: EnBW New Ventures is the venture capital arm of German energy company EnBW. It supports entrepreneurs building sustainable solutions, combining a financially driven VC approach with the reach and skills of its corporate parent.

fieldData.name: Droia Ventures
fieldData.profile: Droia Ventures is a Luxembourg-based specialist life sciences investor dedicated to saving patient lives. It invests globally in young drug development companies using novel science.

fieldData.name: DFJ Growth
fieldData.profile: DFJ Growth, founded in 2005, invests in emerging technology leaders during their scaling phase. It partners with mission-driven entrepreneurs building game-changing companies.

fieldData.name: Crosslink Capital
fieldData.focus: SaaS and enterprise software, Cybersecurity, AI, Fintech
fieldData.profile: Crosslink Capital is an early-stage venture capital firm that partners with ambitious founders building category-defining companies. It invests in enterprise software, cybersecurity, AI and fintech.

fieldData.name: Credo Ventures
fieldData.profile: Credo Ventures is a venture fund for founders from Central and Eastern Europe building generational companies. It has led pre-seed and early rounds in the region since 2009.

fieldData.name: Conductive Ventures
fieldData.profile: Conductive Ventures backs unconventional, often-overlooked founders building capital-efficient companies in diverse geographies. It invests mostly at Series A and Series B in emerging category leaders.

fieldData.name: Closed Loop Partners
fieldData.profile: Closed Loop Partners is a US investment firm dedicated to accelerating the transition to a circular economy. It invests in, builds and operates businesses that are both profitable and sustainable.

fieldData.name: CapitalT
fieldData.profile: CapitalT is a European venture capital firm in the Netherlands that puts founders first. It believes the category leaders of the next decade will combine commercial success with a positive contribution to people and the planet.

fieldData.name: Camber Creek
fieldData.profile: Camber Creek is a US venture firm that invests in technology for real estate and the built world. Its portfolio includes software for property inspection, insurance data and fraud detection.

fieldData.name: BlueYard Capital
fieldData.stage: Pre-seed, Seed, Series A, Series B
fieldData.profile: BlueYard Capital is a German venture firm that backs founders building the fabric of the future, from breakthroughs in computation, software, engineering and biology to crypto networks. It invests from pre-seed through Series B.

fieldData.name: Bison Ventures
fieldData.profile: Bison Ventures invests in early-stage frontier technology companies focused on healthier people and a healthier planet. It partners with founders pushing the frontier of intelligence into the physical world.

fieldData.name: Bek Ventures
fieldData.stage: Pre-seed, Seed, Series A, Series B
fieldData.profile: Bek Ventures is a Turkish venture firm that calls itself quietly thought-provoking, staying silent most of the time except when it counts. It invests from pre-seed to Series B.

fieldData.name: Balderton Capital
fieldData.profile: Balderton Capital is a London venture firm that has worked with hundreds of European founders over 26 years. It has raised more than $5.7 billion across 12 funds.

fieldData.name: BMW i Ventures
fieldData.profile: BMW i Ventures is the venture arm of BMW, operating with the speed of a Silicon Valley VC while drawing on BMW as a corporate partner. Its portfolio includes Xometry, the on-demand manufacturing platform.

fieldData.name: Axon Partners Group
fieldData.profile: Axon Partners Group is a Spanish investment and advisory firm that partners with visionary leaders building technology-driven businesses during a time of major social, economic and environmental change. It makes growth investments alongside its consulting work.

fieldData.name: Axeleo Capital
fieldData.stage: Pre-seed, Seed, Series A, Series B
fieldData.profile: Axeleo Capital is a Paris-based investment firm with €300 million under management, backing European B2B software and industrial greentech from pre-seed to Series B. It has made more than 70 investments and seen more than 20 exits.

fieldData.name: Astanor Ventures
fieldData.profile: Astanor Ventures is a Belgian investor working to transform the agrifood system "from soil and sea to gut". It scales businesses across the sector through two strategies, Astanor Venture and Astanor Growth.

fieldData.name: Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund
fieldData.profile: The Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund is a $1 billion corporate venture capital fund that invests directly in emerging technology companies. It focuses on innovation that improves the employee and customer experience in Amazon's operations.

fieldData.name: Alpine Space Ventures
fieldData.profile: Alpine Space Ventures is a German venture capital firm led by industry insiders that invests exclusively in early-stage space companies. Its portfolio includes Northwood Space, which builds ground infrastructure for satellites.

fieldData.name: Allianz X
fieldData.profile: Allianz X is the investment arm of Allianz, based in Germany. It invests in mature digital frontrunners in ecosystems relevant to insurance and asset management, from fintech and health to mobility and cybersecurity.

fieldData.name: AgFunder
fieldData.profile: AgFunder is a global venture capital firm backing deep tech platforms across AI, biotech, robotics, manufacturing, climate and materials. It focuses on the limiting factors for food, agriculture and planetary health.

fieldData.name: Activant Capital
fieldData.focus: SaaS and enterprise software, Fintech, E-commerce and marketplaces
fieldData.profile: Activant Capital is a research-led global investment firm that partners with high-growth founders building category-defining technology companies, through their most defining stages of growth. It invests at Series B and growth stages, with a focus on software, fintech and commerce.

fieldData.name: 1kx
fieldData.profile: 1kx is a research-driven global crypto investment firm working to make trust instant, open and programmable. It has made more than 160 investments since 2018 across DeFi, stablecoins and onchain infrastructure.

fieldData.name: 1991 Ventures
fieldData.profile: 1991 Ventures has backed Ukrainian startups since 2016. Its accelerator has supported more than 315 startups that raised over $60 million, and its £15 million seed fund invests in founders from Central and Eastern Europe and Ukraine.

fieldData.name: 10x Founders
fieldData.profile: 10x Founders is a German venture firm built by entrepreneurs, super angels and early-stage investors. It supports ambitious founders building global businesses, drawing on decades of experience as operators and CEOs.

fieldData.name: .406 Ventures
fieldData.profile: .406 Ventures is a Boston venture firm that partners with early-stage companies with home-run potential. For 20 years it has worked closely with founders to turn their companies into category leaders.

fieldData.name: Worklife
fieldData.focus: SaaS and enterprise software, AI, Future of work
fieldData.profile: Worklife is a San Francisco venture capital firm founded by Brianne Kimmel. It calls itself the first creator-friendly VC firm and invests in tools and services for the modern workplace.

fieldData.name: Will Ventures
fieldData.focus: Media and creator economy, Consumer, Health, Gaming and sports, AI, Education
fieldData.profile: Will Ventures is a Boston early-stage venture firm that invests in category-defining consumer, health and media businesses. Its team of entrepreneurs, operators and investors describes itself as competitors with a hustle-first mentality.

fieldData.name: VoLo Earth Ventures
fieldData.focus: Climate and energy, Mobility and logistics, Deep tech and hardware, AI, Real estate and proptech
fieldData.profile: VoLo Earth Ventures is a Denver-based venture firm that provides first-in funding and hands-on leadership to companies driving an economics-led transformation of the global energy economy. Its investments span clean energy, mobility, hardware, AI and the built environment.

fieldData.name: VSC Ventures
fieldData.profile: VSC Ventures is a Zurich-based venture fund that backs audacious founders and amplifies their stories. It builds portfolio companies' brands and runs a media operation to help them win faster with customers, employees and investors.

fieldData.name: Unshackled Ventures
fieldData.profile: Unshackled Ventures is a Palo Alto firm that writes the first check for "Day 0" founders. It backs bold technical founders, many of them immigrants, with capital, immigration support and conviction, often before product, revenue or visa.

fieldData.name: Sfermion
fieldData.profile: Sfermion is a Chicago multi-strategy investment firm focused on the immersive internet. It invests in the founders, companies and assets accelerating the merger of the physical and digital worlds.

fieldData.name: SJF Ventures
fieldData.profile: SJF Ventures is a Durham, North Carolina venture firm that invests in high-growth companies creating a healthier, smarter and cleaner future. Its mission is to build highly successful businesses that drive lasting, positive change.

fieldData.name: Quona Capital
fieldData.profile: Quona Capital is a Washington, D.C. venture firm that invests in fintech innovators advancing financial inclusion around the world. It aims to deliver strong financial returns while making a lasting positive impact.

fieldData.name: Owl Ventures
fieldData.profile: Owl Ventures is a San Francisco venture firm and a global leader in edtech investing, with $2.2 billion under management across seven funds. It backs AI-driven learning and workforce companies at every stage.

fieldData.name: Operator Partners
fieldData.stage: Pre-seed, Seed, Series A, Series B
fieldData.profile: Operator Partners is a New York firm that invests only its own capital, with no outside LPs. It backs technology companies at pre-seed, seed and Series A and partners with founders it can help win.

fieldData.name: K9 Ventures
fieldData.profile: K9 Ventures is a technology-focused micro VC fund based in Palo Alto, California. Its portfolio companies share a passion for using technology to solve real problems.

fieldData.name: Interlock Partners
fieldData.focus: SaaS and enterprise software, Education, E-commerce and marketplaces, AI, Real estate and proptech, Mobility and logistics
fieldData.profile: Interlock Partners is a Dallas venture capital firm that invests in companies positioned to win. It accelerates success through a hands-on approach drawn from its operating experience.

fieldData.name: Heritage Group
fieldData.profile: Heritage Group is a Nashville healthcare investor that partners with companies addressing healthcare's greatest challenges. It is backed by leading US healthcare organizations that take an active role in supporting its portfolio, and its team has more than 35 years of experience as entrepreneurs and investors.

fieldData.name: Heartland Ventures
fieldData.profile: Heartland Ventures is a South Bend, Indiana venture firm that invests in cutting-edge technology for industrial businesses. It connects early-stage startups with its network of industrial companies and industry experts.

fieldData.name: Harpoon Ventures
fieldData.focus: AI, Education, Deep tech and hardware, Cybersecurity
fieldData.profile: Harpoon Ventures is a San Diego venture firm that backs founders building mission-critical technologies. It invests across AI, deep tech, software infrastructure and cybersecurity.

fieldData.name: GoAhead Ventures
fieldData.profile: GoAhead Ventures is a pre-seed and seed venture firm in Menlo Park that operates at startup speed. Founders complete a one-way pitch reviewed by all managing partners, and final decisions come the day after the partner pitch.

fieldData.name: Future Perfect Ventures
fieldData.focus: Crypto and web3, AI, Fintech, SaaS and enterprise software, Media and creator economy, E-commerce and marketplaces
fieldData.profile: Future\Perfect Ventures is a New York early-stage venture firm founded in 2014 by Jalak Jobanputra. It invests globally in blockchain technology and crypto assets.

fieldData.name: Foundation Capital
fieldData.profile: Foundation Capital is a Palo Alto venture firm that has backed extraordinary founders from day zero for thirty years. Its portfolio has included Solana.

fieldData.name: Engineering Capital
fieldData.profile: Engineering Capital is a Palo Alto seed firm that partners with entrepreneurs driven by technical insight. It leads seed rounds before traditional venture firms are willing, in companies defining new categories in information technology.

fieldData.name: DigiTx Partners
fieldData.focus: Health, Biotech and life sciences, Data and analytics, AI
fieldData.profile: DigiTx Partners is a San Francisco venture firm investing in digital health and data-driven companies. It partners with founders using technology and meaningful data to improve healthcare and patient outcomes.

fieldData.name: Cisco Investments
fieldData.profile: Cisco Investments is the venture arm of Cisco. It invests in enterprise technology startups where Cisco has deep expertise, helping them grow into enterprises with access to Cisco's global development expertise.

fieldData.name: CMFG Ventures
fieldData.focus: Fintech, Health, Consumer, Real estate and proptech, Cybersecurity, Education
fieldData.profile: CMFG Ventures, now TruStage Ventures, is the venture capital arm of TruStage, based in Madison, Wisconsin. It invests in the next generation of financial technology to help credit union members achieve better financial security.

fieldData.name: Builders VC
fieldData.profile: Builders VC is a San Francisco venture firm backing founders solving complex, mission-critical problems with technology that transforms legacy systems in essential industries such as healthcare. Its portfolio includes companies named to TIME's Best Inventions of 2026.

fieldData.name: Booz Allen Ventures
fieldData.profile: Booz Allen Ventures is the venture arm of Booz Allen Hamilton. It invests in technologies that advance critical civil, defense and national security missions.

fieldData.name: Blockchange Ventures
fieldData.profile: Blockchange Ventures is a venture fund designed to invest in the early rounds of the largest blockchain outcomes. It backs founders whose visions are as big as the blockchain shift itself.

fieldData.name: Arrington Capital
fieldData.profile: Arrington Capital is a thesis-driven venture capital firm investing in digital assets and Web3 technology. Since 2017 it has invested in more than 200 early-stage crypto companies.

fieldData.name: Amino Capital
fieldData.profile: Amino Capital is a Palo Alto venture firm that invests at pre-seed, seed, Series A and Series B. It backs data-driven technology startups.

fieldData.name: Air Street Capital
fieldData.profile: Air Street Capital is a London venture capital firm founded in 2019 by Nathan Benaich. It invests exclusively in AI-first companies across frontier AI, infrastructure, autonomy, defense technology and TechBio, and recently announced a $232 million fund.

fieldData.name: Zetta Venture Partners
fieldData.profile: Zetta Venture Partners backs founders pushing the frontier of AI in science and building tools for discovery. It provides day-zero capital and hands-on support to scientific founders.

fieldData.name: Vektor Partners
fieldData.profile: Vektor Partners is a UK venture firm investing in critical technologies driving the world's shift toward AI, automation and decarbonization, with a focus on AI and software-enabled businesses. It has a particular focus on mobility and the technologies changing how people and goods move.

fieldData.name: VGames
fieldData.profile: VGames is an Israeli founder-first venture fund investing in gaming and consumer startups. It backs game studios, apps and consumer companies from inception to growth.

fieldData.name: Upside Partnership
fieldData.profile: Upside Partnership is a seed and pre-seed venture capital firm that believes early investing is about people. It looks for "inevitable founders" who want investors who work for them.

fieldData.name: TLV Partners
fieldData.focus: Internet, Fintech, IoT, Mobile, Enterprise, Cybersecurity
fieldData.profile: TLV Partners is an Israeli venture firm that invests in early-stage startups. Since 2015 it has backed Israeli founders from day zero to build category-defining companies.

fieldData.name: SE Ventures
fieldData.profile: SE Ventures is the venture fund backed by Schneider Electric, based in France. It acts as a growth engine for founders who can benefit from Schneider Electric's global customer base and domain expertise in energy and industry.

fieldData.name: Plural
fieldData.profile: Plural is a UK venture community of regulatory experts, operators and investors. It provides early-stage companies with investment and intellectual capital to build the future of finance.

fieldData.name: Next Gear Ventures
fieldData.profile: Next Gear Ventures is an Israeli venture fund focused on entrepreneurs pioneering sustainable, smart mobility. It supports early-stage ventures with an ecosystem designed to help them scale.

fieldData.name: Myriad Venture Partners
fieldData.profile: Myriad Venture Partners provides capital, insights and an ecosystem to entrepreneurs building enduring companies that define industries, with a focus on business solutions. It sets out its approach in what it calls the Myriad Model, a set of guiding principles for how it works with founders.

fieldData.name: Munich Re Ventures
fieldData.profile: Munich Re Ventures is the venture arm of reinsurer Munich Re. It works globally as a strategic and financial investor in disruptive technologies and business models that shape the future of risk.

fieldData.name: Morningside
fieldData.profile: Morningside makes venture capital investments in companies built on novel science and technology. It backs companies at early stages, with a long record in life sciences and technology.

fieldData.name: Middleland Capital
fieldData.profile: Middleland Capital is a thematic venture fund investing in foodtech and agtech companies working to catalyze global change in food and health. Its team has invested in food and agriculture technology since 2009.

fieldData.name: Maven11
fieldData.profile: Maven11 is an Amsterdam-based blockchain investment firm with ten years in digital assets. It invests in the protocols, platforms and applications defining the next wave of global finance, particularly DeFi, payments and financial infrastructure.

fieldData.name: Latitude
fieldData.profile: Latitude is a UK venture investor that connects the fastest-growing startups with the world's biggest companies. It helps its portfolio companies build relationships with large corporate customers and partners.

fieldData.name: Lanchi Ventures
fieldData.profile: Lanchi Ventures is a venture capital firm in China that backs daring entrepreneurs using technology to redefine the future. It invests in early-stage startups across AI, robotics, consumer, biotech and healthcare, managing multiple funds with more than $2 billion in assets.

fieldData.name: Koch Disruptive Technologies
fieldData.profile: Koch Disruptive Technologies is the venture and growth investment arm of Koch. It helps entrepreneurs innovate and scale with flexible capital and access to its global partner community.

fieldData.name: Kinnevik
fieldData.profile: Kinnevik is a Swedish growth investor that acts as an entrepreneurial investor, active owner and operational partner to challenger companies in Europe and the US. It provides patient capital to build remarkable growth companies.

fieldData.name: Ironspring Ventures
fieldData.profile: Ironspring Ventures is an early-stage venture firm investing across the industrial supply chain. It backs startups in construction, manufacturing, transport and logistics, and alternative energy.

fieldData.name: Icon Ventures
fieldData.profile: Icon Ventures is a venture firm that believes AI is reshaping every industry and that startups need partners who know how to create enduring value, not just capital. It positions itself as a hands-on partner to founders building AI-era companies.

fieldData.name: Hatteras Venture Partners
fieldData.profile: Hatteras Venture Partners is a healthcare venture capital firm investing in biotech, medtech and healthtech companies advancing patient care. Its team of entrepreneurs and scientists invests broadly across healthcare.

fieldData.name: Hack VC
fieldData.profile: Hack VC is a venture capital firm that invests in Web3 and crypto companies. It backs founders building crypto infrastructure and applications.

fieldData.name: Graph Ventures
fieldData.profile: Graph Ventures is an early-stage fund for founders, run by founders. It invests when companies are starting out and draws on more than 10 years of investing and company building to help founders close their rounds.

fieldData.name: GP Bullhound
fieldData.profile: GP Bullhound is a UK technology investment and advisory firm that has invested in and advised founders since 1999. It has more than 180 employees across 13 offices worldwide and advises on M&A, exits and growth capital.

fieldData.name: GMO Venture Partners
fieldData.profile: GMO Venture Partners is the Japanese venture arm of the GMO Internet Group, with a focus on fintech. It recently held a first close of its GMO Fintech Fund 8, and portfolio company Rentomojo has listed on India's stock exchanges.

fieldData.name: Forestay Capital
fieldData.profile: Forestay Capital is a Geneva-based growth investor backing enterprise AI and SaaS companies at their inflection point. It leads Series A to Series C rounds across Europe, Israel and the US.

fieldData.name: Foresite Capital
fieldData.profile: Foresite Capital is a multi-stage healthcare and life sciences investment firm. It invests in companies that use biology and big data to transform healthcare, in areas of great unmet need.

fieldData.name: Fall Line Capital
fieldData.profile: Fall Line Capital is a specialist investment firm with deep roots in the global food system, investing in venture capital and real assets. It backs exceptional founders building the future of food.

fieldData.name: FPV Ventures
fieldData.profile: FPV Ventures invests in mission-driven founders who are in it for the long haul. It aims to be with them from the start and support them through the long, often lonely work of building.

fieldData.name: Emerald Technology Ventures
fieldData.profile: Emerald Technology Ventures is a Swiss venture firm that invests in sustainable industrial innovation. It backs startups solving global problems and connects them with corporations looking to accelerate innovation.

fieldData.name: Dawn Capital
fieldData.profile: Dawn Capital is a UK venture firm that backs B2B software founders. It describes itself as thoughtful rather than theatrical, opening doors and unlocking talent for its companies.

fieldData.name: Creator Fund
fieldData.profile: The Creator Fund is a UK venture firm that backs scientific founders creating businesses that will rewrite how the world works, on the belief that the future will be built by scientists. It invests at the earliest stages in companies built on deep scientific research.

fieldData.name: Coughdrop
fieldData.profile: Coughdrop Capital is an early-stage venture firm founded by brothers Austin Petersmith and Stu Smith. It makes investment decisions within 24 hours of meeting founders.

fieldData.name: Correlation Ventures
fieldData.profile: Correlation Ventures is a venture firm that uses data science and industry networks to make investment decisions within days. Its portfolio has included Synthorx, Personal Capital and Imperfect Foods.

fieldData.name: Cathay Innovation
fieldData.profile: Cathay Innovation is a global, multi-stage venture capital firm based in France that connects ambitious startups with Fortune 500 corporate ecosystems. It backs founders building technologies that rewire how people live and work.

fieldData.name: Cardumen Capital
fieldData.profile: Cardumen Capital is an Israeli early-stage venture firm that invests in visionary founders transforming the world through technology, with a focus on AI, cybersecurity and software infrastructure. Its name comes from the Spanish word for a shoal of fish, reflecting how its partners invest together as a team.

fieldData.name: Calibrate Ventures
fieldData.profile: Calibrate Ventures backs founders scaling deep tech to transform industries such as manufacturing, security and warehousing. It funds AI, computer vision, machine learning, robotics and automation startups.

fieldData.name: Breakthrough Energy Ventures
fieldData.profile: Breakthrough Energy Ventures empowers innovators building the future of energy. Its portfolio spans the clean industrial revolution, from carbon removal and storage to new energy technologies.

fieldData.name: Alpha Edison
fieldData.profile: Alpha Edison is an investment firm that partners with early-stage entrepreneurs using technology to build category-creating companies that unlock new markets. It invests at the early stage and works closely with founders to build new markets.

fieldData.name: 10D
fieldData.profile: 10D is an Israeli venture firm that gives its companies access to talent and design partners beyond their own networks. Its portfolio has included DriveNets.

fieldData.name: WndrCo
fieldData.profile: WndrCo builds and backs the companies defining what comes next. It is a venture firm, holding company and founder community based in Silicon Valley and New York.

fieldData.name: Rocketship.vc
fieldData.profile: Rocketship.vc is a Los Altos venture firm that combines founder experience with data science and a large database of startup activity. Its partners wrote a widely used textbook on data mining.

fieldData.name: Quiet Capital
fieldData.profile: Quiet Capital is a San Francisco venture firm of builders who invest in remarkable founders from day zero. It backs remarkable founders from the very beginning, investing alongside them as fellow builders.

fieldData.name: GreatPoint Ventures
fieldData.profile: GreatPoint Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm in San Francisco founded by entrepreneurs and company builders. It aims to give founders the kind of hands-on support its partners valued when building their own companies.

fieldData.name: Base10 Partners
fieldData.profile: Base10 Partners is a San Francisco venture firm investing in automation for the real economy. Its founders have built companies worth more than $3 billion combined, and the firm donates 50% of its profits to the next generation of technology founders.

fieldData.name: Catapult Ventures
fieldData.profile: Catapult Ventures is an independent UK fund manager whose owners have run venture capital funds totaling about £130 million for public and private investors. It supports entrepreneurs and business owners in reaching their goals.
